With the UTR track alone the shares are introns 29.2%, CDS 20.4%, intergenic 18.2%, transposable elements 16.7%, UTR 7.2%, upstream 3.4%, downstream 2.6%, lncRNA 2.3%. (2) PCA, R3.1-015. In the plane of PC1 and PC2 no straight line splits heat from control libraries, so the row matches, but with PC3 one does: the same expression with PC1 + PC2 + PC3, or with PC2 + PC3, returns FALSE in both modes at 1x and at 10x. Wilcoxon tests of the 1x legacy scores by treatment give p = 0.007 on PC2 and 0.000006 on PC3. Ploidy is not separable with four components. This is the cohort difference of I-01 and issues.md does not record it. If the audit adopts a criterion on more than the two plotted components, expression_corrected of R3.1-015 could become tab("04_cpg_coverage", "pca_scores_1x_corrected.csv")[, any((fitted(suppressWarnings(glm((treatment == "heat") ~ PC1 + PC2 + PC3, family = binomial))) > 0.5) != (treatment == "heat"))], which was run and returns FALSE. (3) Correlation range, R3.1-012 and R3.1-013. Recomputed from the June 2021 coverage files with methylKit-style normalization: among the ten heat libraries alone, 0.878 to 0.925 on the 4,194,066 CpGs with 5x in all ten, and 0.885 to 0.940 on the 1,921,856 CpGs with 10x in all ten. The first is the setting of 08_archive/code/2_WGBS_Methylkit.R (its correlation plot survives only as a blank image in 08_archive/plots). The heat pairs of the step 04 matrix at 10x (480,579 CpGs) span 0.875 to 0.937. These are the nearest values to 0.87 to 0.93; they suggest that the range describes the heat libraries of the earlier heat-only analysis, which would be a second item of this section taken from it, but this is not confirmed, because that analysis used an earlier alignment. (4) 12,794,074, R3.1-001, stays untraced. Counts on the June 2021 files, every line read: a read in at least one library 12,918,252; in at least two libraries 12,699,295; at least two reads in one library 12,470,054; summed coverage of at least two 12,768,423; the ten heat libraries alone 12,741,110; the union in file order grows from 12,773,551 after 11 libraries to 12,801,892 after 12. None equals the draft's value. (5) Percent mCpG ANOVA, R3.1-032 to R3.1-035. The two-decimal %mCpG column of the hand-built sheet reproduces the draft exactly (F = 14.4861; p = 0.0012938, 0.8615, 0.4215). The unrounded ratios of the counts typed in the same sheet give F = 14.39 and treatment p = 0.425, so the gap to step 03 (14.43 and 0.400) has two sources: the March 2021 alignment for nine heat libraries, and rounding to two decimals. CHOICES MADE. Tolerance follows the rule as written: 0 for counts, half a unit of the last printed digit for everything else, which gives 0.5 for coverage thresholds and degrees of freedom. Criteria were set where the draft gives none and are stated in item and note: a 5% difference for R3.1-011, a straight line in the plane of PC1 and PC2 for R3.1-014 and R3.1-015. Every row split from one test carries the issues of that test. expression_corrected is the corrected mode for quantities computed from CpGs, the deduplicated assay (I-13) for the percent mCpG rows whose value can change, and empty for the ELISA rows, for degrees of freedom and for parameters. Items were reworded for R3.1-011, R3.1-014, R3.1-015, R3.1-028, R3.1-029 and R3.1-036 to R3.1-039 to state the criterion or the scale; IDs, quotes and manuscript values are unchanged. group_summary.csv of step 03 has no rows for the assay before deduplication (group means and Tukey letters as in the draft's analysis), so R3.1-036 computes the group means from pct_mCpG_by_library.csv; adding those rows would be a convenience, not a requirement.
